scope: Category icon, bubble and focused bottom spectrum bar colours. Original category indices unchanged.

rules.focusedBase: Use the selected category's exact icon RGB/hex, without an independent focus tint, channel cap, saturation dampening, dark colour overlay or hue shift.
rules.focusedLighting: Preserve existing gaseous movement and restrained glow/shading without replacing the base hue.
rules.unfocused: Keep the softer ambient illuminated colours of all other segments, not a blanket increase in brightness.
rules.paletteSource: All icons, category bubbles and focused bar segments must read the same category palette rather than parallel hand-coded colour sets.
rules.categoryMembership: No changes to category indexes, filtering rules, location pins or tags.
rules.animation: No changes to the V19 720 ms overlapping visibility morph; spectrum bar itself does not morph.
